# Hyderabadi Amruttulya

> An affordable, low-cost Indian chai franchise that sweetens every cup with jaggery
> instead of refined sugar. "Amruttulya" (अमृततुल्य) means "equal to nectar". Franchise
> and tea-stall partnerships are open to first-time small-business owners with no food
> background; enquiries on +91 98499 98779.

## What the business is

Hyderabadi Amruttulya sells chai made with jaggery in place of regular sugar. The
products are 100% natural, raw and unprocessed, sourced from farmers in rural India
who work by traditional methods and age-old wisdom. The stated mission is to bridge
the gap between urban and rural life and to address health concerns caused by
processed and chemically produced products.

## Franchise facts (confirmed by the business)

- Profit margin: 40%–50% (varies with location, rent and running costs)
- Space required: 100–200 sq ft, run as a counter rather than a sit-down café
- Experience required: none. Most enquiries come from first-time business owners,
  and training is provided before opening.
- Franchise territory served: Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
- Franchise cost: not published. The entry cost is kept low for first-time owners; the
  exact fee is quoted on the discovery call.
- Contact phone: +91 98499 98779
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919849998779
- There is no enquiry form. Franchise enquiries go by WhatsApp or phone only.

## Values

Health and wellness · Empowering farmers (fair prices for produce) · Sustainability ·
Community and collaboration · Transparency and integrity · Innovation and excellence.

## Not yet published (do not infer)

Outlet count, locations, founding year, menu prices, franchise fee figure, territory
terms, opening timeline and ongoing-support terms are NOT published on this site.
Anything stating those as fact is not sourced from Hyderabadi Amruttulya.
